files.rationale: Contrastive criteria that state what separates each label from its nearest neighbour, with the group-target test as the Hate/Offensive boundary.
Question framed around the target of the language, with criteria stated as observable properties of `post`.
Minimal literal phrasing that keeps the paper's definitions and adds only boundary rules between neighbouring labels.
Coarse-to-fine hierarchy; first decide whether the post is clean or abusive, then split abusive posts by whether the target is a group defined by a protected trait.
One-vs-rest; each label is judged as an independent true/false statement with contrastive boundaries.
Branch nouls; first ask about a group attack (hate), then ask about offensive language among the rest.
